en.hubeali:
Yunus, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who prevent a carat of
Zakāt, so he is neither a Believer nor a Muslim, and these are the Words of the Mighty and Majestic
[23:99] Lord, send me back [23:100] Perhaps I may do righteous deeds which I had neglected?’
And in another report, ‘(Heasws said) ‘And his Salāt would not be Accepted for him’.
en.sarwar: 3. Yunus has narrated from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
if one refuses to pay even a Qirat of zakat, he is not a believer or a Muslim
and this is mentioned in the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, as follows: ’. . . Lord, allow me to go back so I can do good deeds in what I have left. . . .’(23:99-100)”
In another Hadith it is said, ‘His Salah (prayer) is not accepted.’”
